name: Kallynteria
summary: The adorning of Athena after the Plynteria washing — the Praxiergidai clean the temple, relight the sacred lamp, and restore the goddess to her peplos and jewelry so the closed sanctuary opens again.
testimonia: Photius / Suda s.v. Καλλυντήρια (the cleaning and adorning rites)
Mikalson (1975) 163–165 (after the Plynteria; day within 24–28 Thargelion approximate)
